scenarios.name: Fake Reconnection Scam
scenarios.description: Stranger pretends to know you from the past. Sends a friendly 'long time no see' or 'hope you're doing well' message. Builds brief rapport, then quickly moves to scheduling a call or meeting via an external link (Calendly, Zoom, Google Meet). Often impersonates someone from the same industry, crypto space, or professional network. The goal is to get you on a call where they pitch a scam investment, fake partnership, or extract information.
indicators: Claims past connection without specifics ('it's been a while', 'long time')
Generic friendly greeting with compliments
Private message, not in a group
Quickly proposes a call or video meeting
Sends scheduling link (Calendly, Zoom, etc.)
Vague about how they know you
Profile may look professional but is newly created
conversation_pattern: Asks what you're up to / how things are going

scenarios.name: Pig Butchering / Romance Investment Scam
scenarios.description: Builds a personal or romantic relationship over days or weeks through regular friendly messages. Eventually introduces a 'great investment opportunity', trading platform, or crypto scheme. Gains deep trust before asking for money. Often operates from organized scam farms.
indicators: Unsolicited friendly DM from attractive profile
Personal questions about life, work, hobbies
Mentions investment success casually in conversation
Introduces a specific platform or trading opportunity after trust is built
Conversation spans multiple days or weeks before the pitch
May share 'screenshots' of profits
conversation_pattern: Initial friendly contact (may claim wrong number or random connection)

scenarios.name: Fake Job / Task Scam
scenarios.description: Offers a remote job or task-based work opportunity with unusually high pay for simple work. Requires an upfront deposit, platform registration fee, or 'activation payment'. Common in Russian and Chinese language Telegram groups.
indicators: Unsolicited job offer in group chat or DM
Unrealistically high pay for simple tasks
Asks to DM for details
Requires upfront payment or deposit to start
Vague job description
Claims 'many vacancies available'
Promises remote work with flexible hours
conversation_pattern: Posts job ad in group or sends DM
Promises high pay for easy remote work
Directs to DM or external platform
Asks for larger deposits to 'unlock' higher pay

scenarios.name: Fake Admin / Support Scam
scenarios.description: Impersonates a group admin or project support staff. Reaches out via DM after the victim asks a question in a group chat. Offers to 'help' with wallet connection, token issues, or technical support, then directs to a phishing site or asks for seed phrases.
indicators: DM from someone claiming to be admin/support shortly after group post
Username similar to real admin but slightly different
Asks to connect wallet via a link
Requests seed phrase or private key for 'verification'
Claims urgency ('your funds are at risk')
conversation_pattern: Scammer DMs claiming to be support
Offers to help with the issue
Sends a phishing link or asks for credentials

scenarios.name: Fake Airdrop / Giveaway
scenarios.description: Announces a fake airdrop, token giveaway, or reward program. Requires connecting a wallet to a malicious site, sending crypto to 'receive' more back, or sharing personal information to 'claim' rewards.
indicators: Announces free tokens or crypto rewards
Requires connecting wallet to unknown site
Asks to send crypto to receive more back
Creates urgency ('limited time', 'first 100 people')
Links to sites mimicking legitimate projects
conversation_pattern: Site asks for wallet connection or seed phrase
May ask for small 'gas fee' payment
